items.title: 2 Reasons to Watch ACN and 1 to Stay Cautious
items.summary: Over the past six months, Accenture’s stock price fell to $178.52. Shareholders have lost 14.7% of their capital, which is disappointing considering the S&P 500 has climbed by 13.6%. This was partly driven by its softer quarterly results and might have investors contemplating their next move.
